title: Ternary algebra splitting of V_24 and V_15

V24_splitting.interpretation: Two copies of 10-dim rep (SU(5) antisymmetric?) + 4 singlets

V15_splitting.interpretation: Two copies of 6-dim rep (SO(4) antisymmetric?) + 3 singlets

eigenvalue_structure.note: q/2 = 3/2 is the spin-1/2 × q structure

physics_interpretation.V24_as_10+10+4x1: Two 10-dim GUT reps (L and R?) + 4 gauge singlets
physics_interpretation.three_singlets_in_V15: Could be the 3 electroweak gauge bosons
